result: In `packet_fifo_core`, replace the `integer read_ptr` and `integer write_ptr` declarations with unsigned vectors sized to represent indices `0` through `DEPTH-1`, using a minimum width of one bit. Keep the existing explicit `DEPTH-1` wrap behavior for both pointer updates, including `DEPTH=1`; preserve occupancy, registered output updates, and all transfer and reset behavior. Keep the top `// @latency 1` annotation and interface unchanged. Retain the candidate only if the unchanged verification flow passes and routed setup and hold remain nonnegative, with LUTs strictly below 107 (or, at equal LUTs, FFs below 102).
